integrity: The lower bound is an exhaustive finite search in a relaxation that gives \(\mathsf R\) and \(\mathsf S\) zero cost, so it cannot overstate the true distance. The upper paths are replayed transition by transition with an independent standard-library checker.
scientific_limitations: Only the two named nine-petal representatives \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are covered, for the move set \(\mathcal M\); no distance is asserted for \(\gamma\), all hard words, or other generating sets. Knot type and hardness are prior certified inputs rather than recomputed here.
title: Exact eight-move untangling distances for two minimal hard petal unknots
